inputs.text: Photorealistic live-action Chinese period drama, 32mm wide rear view. At the lower-right third stands a fictional adult Chinese court astronomer, face hidden, high coiled black updo and narrow gold crown. Her outer robe is unmistakably DARK TEAL with wide cream trim; only her waist sash is OXBLOOD RED. Half-open carved double doors frame a moonlit terrace and distant original city gate tower glowing dark crimson. Straight door frames, sharp wood and roof tiles, deep blue night, warm interior spill, detailed shadows, cinematic vertical composition.
